items.question: How many working days does it take to activate a company's account after it registers in the UAE Federal Supplier Register, once all requirements are completed?
items.fact: Federal Supplier Register account activated within 30 working days.

items.question: According to the UAE Federal Procurement Catalogue, roughly how many minutes does a purchase take, compared with 60 days previously?
items.fact: Federal Procurement Catalogue reduces purchasing from 60 days to about 6 minutes.
